wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Neto the Time Weaver | image = Neto the Time Weaver.png | title = Time Logistics Officer | level = 57 | faction = Neutral | aggro = {{Aggro|1|1}} | affiliation = [[Wardens of Time]] | race = High elf | creature = Humanoid | location = [[Caverns of Time]], [[Tanaris]] | gender = Male }} '''Neto the Time Weaver''' is a [[high elf]] located in the [[Caverns of Time]] in [[Tanaris]].
